messages:
Noah L.: Quick alert: Forwarder reports customs flagged a consolidated RMA shipment for EU as mis-declared HS code which triggered a hold. They want to reissue AWB and split to release. How bad is this for our APAC top-off plan?
Maya - Sourcing: That was supposed to be separate repo vs returns. Which AWB?
Noah L.: Fulfillment Bot: AWB ASH1234CONSOL flagged, manifest shows H100 units declared under HS 8471.80 instead of 8542.31. Forwarder - AeroShip: We can refile under new AWB but need vendor signoff and additional handling fee  450. Splitting to two AWBs reduces hold time but costs extra.
Evan (Ops): If we split, depot signoff will be faster for DOAs but we'll pay  450. If we don't, hold could add 5 days. For APAC top-off that means delayed provisioning affecting a few clusters.
Clara - Legal: Who declared HS? Vendor or forwarder? Liability matters. If vendor provided manifest, they might be on the hook. If forwarder translated it, maybe not.
Maya - Sourcing: Vendor sent CSV with HS 8542.31 but forwarder converted in system to 8471.80 (bug). We need carrier logs.
Fulfillment Bot: Vendor ZenithX: CSV shows correct HS. Carrier logs show auto-classification override. Forwarder - AeroShip: We have automation that maps to legacy codes for telecom gear. We can revert, but it needs manual refile.
Noah L.: Proposal: Ask forwarder to refile and split AWB: 6 units to AWB ASH1234A (urgent), 10 units to AWB ASH1234B (consolidated). We pay  450 handling; vendor to cover if manifest mismatch was from their portal.
Evan (Ops): Agree. Also require vendor to attach serial photos and QR labels before we accept split AWBs to speed depot acceptance.
Maya - Sourcing: I'll push vendor to accept liability for handling fee since they originated the manifest via their portal. Also ask them to confirm per-unit photos within 12h.
Fulfillment Bot: Vendor ZenithX: Acknowledged manifest discrepancy. Will approve split AWB and provide per-unit photos within 18h. Requests vendor payment for  450 if manifest originated from vendor.
Clara - Legal: Keep proof. If vendor doesn't pay, we reserve right to offset against next invoice. Document acceptance of split in email.
Noah L.: Ok we split. Forwarder to confirm new AWBs and ETA change. Post final AWBs here when issued.
Forwarder - AeroShip: New AWBs issued: ASH1234A (urgent) ETA 1797209000, ASH1234B ETA 1797220000. Additional handling fee charged to shipper.
Evan (Ops): Noted. I'll book depot window for ASH1234A arrival and tag 4 units for immediate DOA triage.
Maya - Sourcing: Also track vendor invoice resolution for  450. If they push back, escalate to procurement manager.
Noah L.: Thanks everyone. Keep updates tight. Will follow up if vendor refuses fee. :pray:
